newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil telecom bid specs may be out by year's end.
newsitem.headline: Brazil telecom bid specs may be out by year's end.

text.p: Brazil hopes to publish by year's end bid specifications for the sale of state telecoms firms Telesp and Embratel, a government spokesman said.
"If everything runs normally, the bid specifications for the (companies') privatizations could be launched by the end of the year," a Communications Ministry spokesman said.
The government hopes to sell the entire federal telecoms Telebras system by the end of 1998. Telesp and Embratel are two of Telebras' biggest units.
But potential snags ranging from legal challanges to delays in passing the General Telecommunications Law could set back the selloff process, the spokesman said.
He also confirmed the government could publish as early as July bid specifications to hire consultants analyze Telesp and Embratel provided Congress pass the telecoms law in June as expected.
The consultants would undertake financial and economic evaluations of the the firms and recommend sale models and base prices.
"The tender documents for consultants who will analyze the companies should be published 30 days after the approval of the General Telecommunications Law," he said.
